metadata.description: Ask Gina is a research assistant for crypto, prediction markets, perpetuals, and equities. Use it to fetch real-time prices and historical data for tokens, Hyperliquid markets, and Polymarket prediction markets, and to analyze your Gina wallet, positions, and accounts.

plugins.name: ask-gina
plugins.description: Read-only Ask Gina research for wallets, spot tokens, Hyperliquid, and Polymarket. Cannot place trades or transfer assets.

plugins.name: ask-gina-perps
plugins.description: Ask Gina Perps reads Hyperliquid markets and, with your approval, places and manages perpetual-futures orders and funding. Orders and funding move real money.

plugins.name: ask-gina-predictions
plugins.description: Ask Gina Predictions searches Polymarket and, with your approval, trades prediction markets and manages your prediction balance. Trades move real funds.

plugins.name: ask-gina-spot
plugins.description: Ask Gina Spot quotes and, with your approval, executes spot swaps, transfers, and liquidity-pool operations. Transactions move real funds.
